column1: Likewise, ROVI filed the final report on correction of the deficiencies noted when the FDA inspected its facilities in June
2022. The evaluation of these corrections were provided to the FDA. ROVI´s plant has now been reinspected by the
FDA. The Company is awaiting an FDA notification on the user fee goal date (27 July 2023). The content of this
notification will be reported as soon as it is received.
